name: HQ Supervisor
notes: The room's operator: every registered project, onboarding one, the room's incidents and settings. Opens a project's Supervisor; never creates Leads or Peers. Starts only in the hq-seatwork project.

name: Supervisor
notes: One project's Supervisor, opened by the user or HQ inside a registered project. Starts a Lead per request, watches how the room works and proposes the smallest correction. Decides nothing for the project and never goes around a Lead.

name: Lead
notes: Started by a Supervisor, one per request. The root of its work: plans, opens Peers on models from room/models.json, integrates and accepts. Writes no code.

name: Peer
notes: Started by a Lead: one outcome, one scope, on the model the Lead picks from room/models.json. A title [Peer:<spec>] adds a sheet from room/specs (search, scout, review, arch).
